description: Edits a rendered video with the same ops as update_storyboard. Edits that need nothing new (text, order, timing, CTA, captions) apply at once for free as a new spec version, and you get a re-render quote (priced on the edited length) to refresh the MP4. Edits that need new voice-over are not applied: you get a quote_id for confirm_operation. New generated images aren't available: media must come from the project. Only for a video that was rendered at least once.
name: edit_video
title: Edit a rendered video
